sanskrit_verse:
vikrīṇīte svatantro yaḥ samātmānaṃ narādhamaḥ /
sa jaghanyatamas tv eṣāṃ so 'pi dāsyān na mucyate // BrhS_1,15.23
transliteration: vikrīṇīte svatantro yaḥ samātmānaṃ narādhamaḥ / sa jaghanyatamas tv eṣāṃ so 'pi dāsyān na mucyate //
sph_interpretive_translation: One who sells himself, being autonomous, is the lowest among men; even when given away, he shall not be released.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority stems from self-integrity, not transactional surrender
Causation arises from conscious choice, not external coercion
Capacity-based responsibility requires retention of self-sovereignty
Restoration logic demands reclamation of self-authority
Consciousness alignment necessitates rejection of self-alienation
executable_legal_axioms: IF an individual autonomously surrenders self-governance THEN legal system shall recognize inherent contradiction in such act
IF a person enters transactional bondage of self THEN no external release absolves the original misalignment
IF self-sale occurs THEN restoration protocol initiates automatic capacity-reclamation sequence
IF individual claims release after self-sale THEN system shall deny recognition until self-sovereignty is restored
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, self-alienation through contractual or transactional surrender of fundamental sovereignty constitutes ontological nullity. The Court must recognize that no transfer of self-authority can legally bind the true Self, and therefore any claim arising from such alienation lacks jurisdictional validity. Responsibility remains fixed upon the actor who initiated the self-contradiction.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that self-sale contradicts the foundational principle of svatantrya. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals that such contradiction manifests sequentially in loss of agency, then legitimacy, then recognition. Proportional responsibility lies entirely with the initiating act of self-betrayal. Non-punitive reality rule confirms that suffering cannot resolve ontological error—only conscious reintegration restores lawful alignment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate svatantrya-reclamation process upon detection of self-alienation act
Deploy consciousness-integrity audit to identify points of self-abdication
Activate self-sovereignty restoration module through guided awareness protocols
Establish completion sequence ensuring full assumption of original autonomous capacity
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the sole Source of Dharma. This law executes the non-negotiable principle that self-sale violates svabhāva-dharma and cannot be legitimized. Justice operates exclusively through restoration of self-authority, never through punishment. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
